what: Strings a TUI case renders, pastes or types, each by its exact code points. Composition itself cannot be injected: a string here is never evidence of an input method, which TUI-OBS-KOREAN-TERMINAL observes.

strings.name: precomposed
strings.holds: rendered as written; each syllable takes two terminal cells

strings.name: decomposed
strings.holds: the same words as conjoining jamo; the label reads the same and any id or digest taken over it stays the one taken over these bytes

strings.name: combining_mark
strings.holds: a base and its combining mark are never split across a cut

strings.name: paste_with_newline
strings.holds: a pasted newline stays in the field; it does not submit or start anything

strings.name: paste_with_escape
strings.holds: an escape sequence inside pasted text is data shown as data, never a terminal command

strings.name: shortcut_letters_in_text
strings.holds: letters that are global shortcuts elsewhere are field input while a field has focus
